title: Bag Count per Shipment of a Tailwise Autoship Prescription Diet Subscription
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy dispensing standard — prescription diet bags**

(1) The diet days a new prescription diet Autoship shipment carries start from one full fill: the diet prescription's days' supply per fill. The diet prescription is the pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription in status active on file with Tailwise Pharmacy.

(2) One bag lasts the diet prescription's days' supply per fill divided by its packages per fill.

(3) The bag count is the diet days divided by the days one bag lasts, rounded up to a whole bag, and never less than one bag.

(4) The bag count never exceeds the packages one fill of the diet prescription authorizes, the Autoship Pharmacy program's most units per shipment, or the whole number of bags whose combined days fit within the Autoship Pharmacy program's largest days' supply in one shipment. Autoship Pharmacy is the program of both the new subscription and the pet's existing subscription.

## Worked figures (hypothetical diet prescriptions; Autoship Pharmacy limits taken as 3 units and 90 days per shipment)

| Diet prescription per fill | Days one bag lasts | Diet days | Bags needed, rounded up | Limits (fill, units, days) | Bag count |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60 days, 2 bags | 30 | 60 | 2 | 2, 3, 3 | 2 |
| 90 days, 6 bags | 15 | 90 | 6 | 6, 3, 6 | 3 |
| 28 days, 1 bag | 28 | 28 | 1 | 1, 3, 3 | 1 |
| 45 days, 2 bags | 22.5 | 45 | 2 | 2, 3, 4 | 2 |

The days limit is the largest days' supply divided by the days one bag lasts, rounded down: 90 divided by 22.5 gives 4 in the last row.
